purpose: Measure whether the first end-to-end V15.7 official Pi0.5/reward/GRPO update has positive real-RoboTwin policy utility before starting a formal 1000-step run or attributing the remaining gap solely to the parent world model.
classification: diagnostic only; nonformal one-update checkpoint and already-consumed historical development seeds

observed_training_signal_before_real_eva.interpretation: The update is nonzero but has a high KL and clipping fraction; real paired evaluation is required before committing the formal budget.

real_evaluation.environment: real RoboTwin adjust_bottle simulator, not V15.7
real_evaluation.seed_status: already consumed historically; reusable for diagnosis only and forbidden for candidate promotion
real_evaluation.paired_baseline: original unmodified Pi0.5 on identical seeds
metrics: overall, left and right success rate
overall, left and right grasp completion rate

decision.positive: If paired real success and grasp are non-regressing, use the result only as evidence to plan formal training and a still-untouched development32 candidate.
decision.negative: If real success or an arm regresses, do not start the 1000-step formal run unchanged; diagnose KL/clipping, reward terminal ranking, and parent transition bias first.
